What Our Team Says About Us

Hear from our team members about their experiences working at Greyamp and how we're shaping the future of technology together.

Nidhi Mittal

Consultant

Greyamp has provided me with opportunities to expand my technical skills and business acumen. What sets this company apart is its culture of pushing us beyond our comfort zones and the absence of a hierarchy. It's been an enriching journey of growth and learning.

Aaquib Khan

Head of Engineering

Greyamp is more than just a workplace; it's a company that genuinely invests in its employees' growth. With a strong focus on personal development, GA provides regular checks on Individual Development Plans (IDPs), continuous guidance, and structured career planning. This nurturing environment empowers us to push our limits and motivates us to achieve both personal and professional success, creating a sense of belonging and family within the organization.

Anna Pauly

Talent Specialist

What makes Greyamp truly special is the incredible support system that surrounds me. From day one, the entire team have been my guiding stars, always there to lend a helping hand and share their wisdom. They have also extended their guidance by acting as mentors instructing me on areas I need to focus and develop on, plan tasks & activities around it with regular check-ins to track my progress. This nurturing environment has given me the confidence to take on more challenging opportunities and contribute effectively to my daily tasks. Every day feels like an adventure, and I couldn't be happier to be part of this amazing journey at Greyamp!

Rajan Suri

DevOps Consultant

Greyamp's distinctive work culture has been instrumental in shaping my professional growth. It’s a place where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement thrive. The emphasis on learning, combined with the freedom to experiment and innovate, has empowered me to take ownership of my work and deliver impactful solutions. This culture not only fosters technical excellence but also instills a deep sense of purpose and satisfaction in everything we do.

Pratyaksh Mangal

Sr Transformation Consultant

My experience at Greyamp Consulting over the past two years has been nothing short of amazing. Working on end-to-end digital transformation projects has provided me with exceptional learning opportunities, allowing me to closely collaborate with different teams. Greyamp has empowered me to work through the entire value cycle—from value identification to realization — delivering impactful solutions for the clients. At Greyamp Consulting, the culture of striving to be a better version of ourselves—1% every day—has been truly inspiring and transformative.

Role Overview

At Greyamp, Transformation Consultants are at the forefront of helping businesses navigate the digital age and unlock their full potential. They drive change and innovation for our clients by enabling them to become more agile, efficient, and customer-centric.If you're passionate about making a real difference in the world, then this role could be the right fit for you!

Key Responsibilities
○
Cultivate an Agile mindset in the team
○
Identify the right agile/business practices and methodologies, and implement the same while guiding, coaching, and enabling client and internal teams
○
Manage expectations of clients and internal stakeholders keep things clear and visible, and deliver value to both clients and our company, Greyamp."
○
Simplify Agile processes for client teams through workshops, sprint planning, and communication
○
Understand the value and need for agile transformation at the client and how improvements can be measured - measures of success or metrics
○
Own and drive the outcomes on ground to achieve the measures of success identified and agreed with the client
○
Coach and assist client team members to drive business value and assist in writing user stories

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our team and help our clients drive data-driven decision-making across our organisation. In this role, you will leverage your deep expertise in statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modelling to solve complex business problems and deliver actionable insights using cutting-edge technologies.

Key Responsibilities
○
Lead end-to-end data science projects from problem definition through deployment and monitoring
○
Conduct comprehensive exploratory data analysis (EDA) to uncover patterns, anomalies, and opportunities in complex datasets
○
Design and implement advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve business challenges
○
Develop and deploy predictive models and time series forecasting solutions for various business applications
○
Build and optimize large language model (LLM) applications and fine-tune foundation models
○
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
○
Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to team knowledge sharing
○
Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders
○
Ensure model performance through continuous monitoring and optimization

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join our team and help build and maintain modern data platforms for Greyamp’s clients. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimising data pipelines and infrastructure that enable data-driven decision-making across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities
○
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to support business analytics and data science initiatives
○
Build and optimize data models, schemas, and architectures for both batch and real-time data processing
○
Implement data quality frameworks, monitoring systems, and alerting mechanisms to ensure data reliability and accuracy
○
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions
○
Optimize query performance and data storage costs across our data platform
○
Maintain and enhance our data infrastructure, including data lakes, warehouses, and streaming platforms
○
Implement data governance practices, including data lineage, cataloging, and access controls
○
Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and provide mentorship to junior team members
○
Document technical solutions, data flows, and best practices for the team
